experiments.name: BASS PMMA Flat Slab Concurrent Flame Spread
experiments.objective: Determine the effect of low-speed concurrent forced airflow on the flame spread rate and extinction limits of thick polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) slabs in microgravity.

measured_variables.name: Flame Spread Rate
measured_variables.definition: Linear velocity of the visible pyrolysis front advancing along the cast PMMA slab surface under concurrent flow.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Digital video camera at 30 fps aligned with optical measurement grid; spatial resolution 0.14 mm/pixel.

measured_variables.name: Flame Length
measured_variables.definition: Tip-to-base visible luminous flame boundary measured along the centerline.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Calibrated color video photogrammetry; threshold at 10% maximum intensity.

measured_variables.name: Peak Surface Temperature
measured_variables.definition: Maximum solid surface temperature recorded by embedded surface thermocouples immediately prior to flame front passage.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Type K micro-thermocouple (0.05 mm diameter wire) flush-mounted into the sample surface.

measured_variables.name: Total Radiative Heat Flux
measured_variables.definition: Peak radiant emission received at a fixed normal distance of 50 mm from the flame zone.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Narrow-angle calibrated radiometer with sapphire window (0.2 to 5.0 μm band).

data_files.description: Multi-channel surface and gas-phase thermocouple temperature traces at 10 Hz sampling rate.
Top-down synchronized color footage of flame spread and soot deposition.

experiments.source_document: Olson, S. L. et al., 'Flame Spread Over Thin and Thick Fuels in Microgravity: Results from the BASS Investigation', Proc. Combust. Inst., 35(3), 2631-2638 (2015).
experiments.notes: Ignition achieved via hot Kanthal wire in contact with slab edge. Steady spread regime established after 15 seconds.

provenance_per_field.airflow: BASS Operations Logbook Rev C, Table 4.1, p. 42 (NASA GRC)
provenance_per_field.oxygen_percent: MSG Life Support telemetry feed record #MSG-2013-098

experiments.name: BASS Cotton-Fiberglass Blend Quenching and Extinction
experiments.objective: Investigate low-speed forced flow extinction limits and flame quenching for thin cotton/fiberglass fabric samples under spacecraft-like ventilation regimes.

measured_variables.name: Flame Spread Rate
measured_variables.definition: Velocity of the leading flame pyrolysis zone on thermally thin fabric prior to quenching.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Digital video camera at 30 fps; edge detection tracking algorithm.

measured_variables.name: Quenching Distance
measured_variables.definition: Minimum stand-off distance between glowing char boundary and metallic holder edge at flame extinction.
measured_variables.sensor_context: High-magnification macro lens video imagery; calibrated against holder markings.

measured_variables.name: Extinction Velocity
measured_variables.definition: Critical minimum concurrent airflow below which the flame fails to sustain combustion and self-extinguishes.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Hot-wire anemometer duct probe calibrated to ±0.1 cm/s.

data_files.description: Flow speed step-down log and optical emission sensor values up to extinction event.

experiments.source_document: Ferkul, P. V. and Olson, S. L., 'Extinction of Flame Spread Over Fabric Samples in Microgravity', Combustion and Flame, 166, 120-128 (2016).
experiments.notes: Hypoxic atmosphere (18% O2) simulated exploration atmosphere regime. Flame suffered radiative extinction when flow dropped below 1.2 cm/s.

provenance_per_field.airflow: MSG duct flow calibrated controller setting F-02
provenance_per_field.oxygen_percent: Chamber mass spectrometer oxygen partial pressure log

experiments.name: ACME Methane Gaseous Diffusion Laminar Flame
experiments.objective: Characterize soot inception, radiative extinction limits, and flame geometry for spherical/cylindrical laminar methane diffusion flames in microgravity.

measured_variables.name: Flame Width
measured_variables.definition: Maximum transverse visible flame boundary diameter in quiescent microgravity environment.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Orthogonal calibrated CCD cameras; 1024x1024 pixel array with narrowband CH* chemiluminescence filter (430 nm).

measured_variables.name: Radiative Extinction Limit
measured_variables.definition: Minimum fuel mass flow rate at which flame self-extinguishes due to radiative heat loss exceeding chemical heat release.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Thermal mass flow meter MFM-01 with 0.1 mg/s precision.

measured_variables.name: Soot Volume Fraction
measured_variables.definition: Peak optical volume fraction of carbonaceous particulate soot within the annular luminous zone.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Line-of-sight laser extinction measurement at 632.8 nm (He-Ne).

data_files.description: Multi-angle laser extinction and chemiluminescence emission spectral matrices.

experiments.source_document: Sunderland, P. B. et al., 'Structure and Extinction of Nonpremixed Methane Flames in Microgravity', Combustion and Flame, 206, 11-21 (2019).
experiments.notes: Absence of buoyant acceleration results in spherical flame morphology and significantly extended residence times compared to terrestrial 1g burners.

provenance_per_field.airflow: CIR sealed combustion chamber quiescent mode
provenance_per_field.oxygen_percent: Gas Delivery System mass flow mixer log #GDS-092
provenance_per_field.pressure: CIR chamber absolute pressure transducer PT-CIR-01

experiments.name: ACME Ethylene Flame Soot and Radiation Dynamics
experiments.objective: Quantify soot generation rates and radiative heat loss fractions for ethylene flames under variable oxygen enrichment in microgravity.

measured_variables.name: Soot Volume Fraction
measured_variables.definition: Maximum local concentration of particulate soot in the luminous flame sheet.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Planar laser-induced incandescence (LII) calibrated with multi-wavelength extinction.

measured_variables.name: Radiative Fraction
measured_variables.definition: Fraction of total chemical heat release lost from the flame via electromagnetic thermal radiation.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Dual broad-band thermopile radiometers positioned at 45° and 90° azimuth.

measured_variables.name: Peak Flame Temperature
measured_variables.definition: Maximum corrected gas temperature within the reaction sheet.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Two-color optical pyrometry verified by radiation-corrected Pt/Rh thermocouple.

data_files.description: Radiometer thermopile microvolt signals and computed heat flux.

experiments.source_document: Urban, D. L. et al., 'Radiation and Soot Processes in Microgravity Nonpremixed Ethylene Flames', Proc. Combust. Inst., 38(3), 4785-4793 (2021).
experiments.notes: High soot yield observed due to lengthened microgravity diffusion residence time without buoyant purging.

experiments.name: Saffire-I Large-Scale Sibal Fabric Flame Spread
experiments.objective: Conduct the first realistic-scale fire safety experiment in an uncrewed space vehicle, measuring flame growth and spread rate over large cotton-fiberglass fabric panels.
experiments.platform: Cygnus Spacecraft (Saffire Flow Duct, post-departure from ISS)

measured_variables.name: Flame Spread Rate
measured_variables.definition: Average velocity of flame front propagation across the large 1.0 m panel.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Synchronized camera array; optical flow tracking and thermocouple arrival time triangulation.

measured_variables.name: Maximum Radiant Heat Flux
measured_variables.definition: Peak radiant emission detected at duct wall during full panel involvement.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Schmidt-Boelter heat flux gauge mounted flush in duct upper plate.

measured_variables.name: Oxygen Depletion Rate
measured_variables.definition: Rate of atmospheric oxygen consumption measured in vehicle cabin during burn period.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Cygnus vehicle life-support electrochemical O2 sensor suite.

data_files.description: Full Cygnus cabin pressure, airflow fan RPM, 24 thermocouple channels, and radiometers.

experiments.source_document: Urban, D. L. et al., 'The Spacecraft Fire Experiment: Saffire-I and Saffire-II Results', Proc. Combust. Inst., 37(3), 4153-4160 (2019).
experiments.notes: Large flame grew in a continuous triangular shape; burning sustained without self-extinguishing throughout the test window.

provenance_per_field.airflow: Saffire flow duct calibrated fan tachometer and differential pressure matrix
provenance_per_field.oxygen_percent: Pre-departure Cygnus cabin gas analysis log

experiments.name: Saffire-II Multi-Material Sample Array Combustion
experiments.objective: Determine maximum burning rate and smoke generation for nine distinct spacecraft engineering plastic samples in low-speed flow in microgravity.

measured_variables.name: Flame Spread Rate
measured_variables.definition: Steady-state flame front velocity along PMMA strip.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Calibrated optical camera and photodiode arrival array.

measured_variables.name: Smoke Optical Density
measured_variables.definition: Attenuation coefficient of smoke obscuration measured downstream of the combustion zone.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Near-IR obscuration beam smoke meter at 880 nm.

measured_variables.name: Peak Surface Temperature
measured_variables.definition: Maximum pyrolysis temperature of solid fuel before vaporization.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Thermocouple TC-PMMA-02 embedded 0.5 mm beneath sample surface.

data_files.description: Video photodiode synchronization and smoke obscuration sensor time trace.

experiments.source_document: Urban, D. L. et al., 'The Spacecraft Fire Experiment: Saffire-I and Saffire-II Results', Proc. Combust. Inst., 37(3), 4153-4160 (2019).
experiments.notes: PMMA sample showed steady bubbling and vigorous jetting at 15 cm/s concurrent flow.

provenance_per_field.airflow: Saffire airflow subassembly calibrated flow meter

experiments.name: FLEX Isolated Droplet Combustion and Cool Flame Extinction
experiments.objective: Observe spherical burning, radiative extinction, and low-temperature 'cool flame' quasi-steady burning of isolated alkane fuel droplets in microgravity.
experiments.material_fuel: n-Heptane Droplet (initial diameter 2.8 mm, SiC fiber suspension)

measured_variables.name: Burning Rate Constant
measured_variables.definition: d²-law evaporation and consumption rate slope constant: -d(D²)/dt during the hot flame phase.
measured_variables.sensor_context: High-magnification backlit silhouette shadowgraphy at 100 fps.

measured_variables.name: Extinction Diameter
measured_variables.definition: Droplet diameter at the moment the visible hot luminous flame extinguishes and cool flame begins.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Shadowgraphy camera paired with UV/visible ICCD camera.

measured_variables.name: Cool Flame Duration
measured_variables.definition: Elapsed time during which droplet continues invisible low-temperature combustion prior to final extinction.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Broadband radiometer in the 2.5-3.5 μm infrared band.

data_files.description: Droplet diameter squared time series extracted via automated ellipse fitting.

experiments.source_document: Nayagam, V. et al., 'Warm and Cool Flame Droplet Extinction in Microgravity', Combustion and Flame, 162(5), 2140-2147 (2015).
experiments.notes: Discovery of two-stage combustion in microgravity where hot flame radiative extinction triggers prolonged cool-flame consumption regime.

experiments.name: SLICES Cylindrical HDPE Rod Concurrent Flame Spread
experiments.objective: Examine the influence of low-speed concurrent flow on flame spread along solid cylindrical thermoplastic fuel rods in microgravity.

measured_variables.name: Flame Spread Rate
measured_variables.definition: Axial regression velocity of the melting and burning front along the HDPE cylinder.
measured_variables.sensor_context: Digital video camera; frame-by-frame front tracking.

experiments.source_document: Bhattacharjee, S. et al., 'Concurrent Flame Spread Over Thick Cylindrical Fuels in Microgravity', AIAA Propulsion and Energy Forum, AIAA 2017-3852 (2017).
experiments.notes: Molten polymer beading observed at flame trailing edge due to surface tension in microgravity.

provenance_per_field.airflow: SLICES wind tunnel fan anemometer setting
